name: AI Chat - OpenAI GPT
description: Sends a prompt from each record to an OpenAI model and adds the reply as a Response field. Uses your own OpenAI API key.
introductoryText:
![OpenAI](data:image/png;base64,)

Sends the prompt in each record to an **OpenAI** model (Chat Completions API) and adds the reply to the record, in a **Response** field, with a **Truncated** field that is true when a reply was cut short.

**To set it up**

1. Paste an OpenAI API key (create one at https://platform.openai.com/api-keys).
2. Choose the **User prompt field**, and optionally a **System prompt field** with the instructions.
3. Keep the default model, gpt-6-luna (OpenAI's model for high-volume tasks), or enter another model ID.

Prompts are sent several at a time (Requests at a time, under Advanced). If any request fails, the block stops with the service's error message and no output.

Each request is billed to your OpenAI account. Prompts and records' text are sent to OpenAI.

options.name: OpenAiApiKey
options.title: OpenAI API key
options.description: A secret key from https://platform.openai.com/api-keys. Usage is billed to its OpenAI account.

options.name: Model
options.title: Model
options.description: The model ID, as listed at https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models, for example gpt-6-luna or gpt-6.1-sol. It must support the Chat Completions API.

options.name: Prompt
options.title: User prompt field
options.description: The field holding each record's prompt: the instruction and the text to work on. Build it with a Formula block if it combines several fields. Numbers and dates are sent as text; records with an empty prompt are not sent.

options.name: SystemPrompt
options.title: System prompt field
options.description: Optional. A field holding instructions that set the model's role, rules and answer format, for example "Reply with one category only: Billing, Delivery or Other". Usually the same text on every record.

options.name: Temperature
options.title: Temperature
options.description: Optional, 0 to 2. Lower values make replies more consistent, higher values more varied. Leave empty to use the model's default. Current GPT models accept a temperature only when reasoning is switched off, so leave it empty for them.

options.name: MaxTokens
options.title: Maximum response length (tokens)
options.description: Optional. The most tokens each reply may use, including the model's hidden reasoning, so a low limit can leave the reply empty. A token is roughly three-quarters of a word. Replies that reach the limit are cut short and marked in the Truncated field. Empty: the model's own maximum.

options.name: Concurrency
options.title: Requests at a time
options.description: How many requests are sent at the same time, 1 to 16. Higher finishes large inputs sooner; lower it if the service reports a rate limit.

blockOutputs.label: Replies
blockOutputs.tooltip: The input records with two fields added: Response (the model's reply) and Truncated (true if the reply stopped at the maximum response length). Records with an empty prompt have both empty.
